title: Tensor section restrictions are natural in the module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ be sheaves of modules on $X$, and $\varphi:F\to G$. For an etale morphism $g:V\to U$ over $X$, write $u:U\to X$ and $v:V\to X$. The unit-normalized tensor restriction $\rho_g$ [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] satisfies $\rho_g^F\,\Gamma(v^*\varphi)=\Gamma(u^*\varphi)\,\rho_g^G$. No quasi-coherence or nonemptiness assumption is needed.

proof.text: The private unit_naturality helper evaluates naturality of the normalized adjunction unit at the top open. The preimage-top transport is definitionally the identity, so its presheaf map cancels.

The private restriction_naturality helper eliminates the structure-morphism equality by subst. It evaluates naturality of tensorSectionsComp at the top open, reassociates, and applies unit_naturality. Specializing to g.left, U.hom, V.hom and g.w proves the public theorem without any new sorry.

theorem etaleTensorSectionsMap_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}} {F G : X.Modules}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) {U V : X.Etale} (g : V ⟶ U) :
    etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F g ≫ ((tensorPullback V.hom).map φ).app ⊤ =
      ((tensorPullback U.hom).map φ).app ⊤ ≫ etaleTensorSectionsRestriction G g
